From scrappy two-person teams to engineering orgs of 200, here's what people say after they switch.

children: Every team used to have three tickets sitting in the analyst queue. Folio's plain-English layer means PMs and ops can pull their own numbers, and the SQL it generates is clean enough to trust. Our data team got their afternoons back.

children: We tried Looker. We tried Metabase. Both required someone on the team to maintain semantic models. Folio just connects to the warehouse and our investors can ask 'what's MRR by cohort' in Slack and get a chart back.

attrs.class: my-4 break-inside-avoid rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background p-4 shadow-sm transition-shadow duration-300 hover:shadow-md

children: I keep checking if our dashboards are real because they just… keep updating. Folio drafts the chart, the query, and the right visualization in one pass. We spent zero engineer hours on the latest exec dashboard.

attrs.class: my-4 break-inside-avoid rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background p-4 shadow-sm transition-shadow duration-300 hover:shadow-md

children: Most BI tools produce charts you'd never put in front of a customer. Folio's defaults are clean enough that I drop them straight into pitch decks. The 'why this chart type' AI nudge is genuinely smart, not gimmicky.

attrs.class: my-4 break-inside-avoid rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background p-4 shadow-sm transition-shadow duration-300 hover:shadow-md

children: Half my job used to be writing ad-hoc data requests for CSMs. Now they ask Folio in Slack — 'renewal rate for accounts over $50K' — and get the answer with the SQL attached, in case they want to verify. Tickets to the data team dropped 70%.

attrs.class: my-4 break-inside-avoid rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background p-4 shadow-sm transition-shadow duration-300 hover:shadow-md

children: We dropped Mode, Hex, a homegrown SQL UI, and an internal chatbot we never finished. All four. Onboarding the team took about an hour and nobody has asked for the old stack back, which says everything.

children: Plugged Folio into Postgres and BigQuery, granted read-only, and we had the first dashboard the same afternoon. Onboarding took less time than reading the docs would've.

relative flex overflow-hidden rounded-full size-10 shrink-0

children: What I appreciate is that Folio doesn't force one query language on us. PMs ask in English, analysts review the SQL, engineers wire the dashboard into our app. Same tool, three workflows, all coherent.

children: Our growth experiments used to wait two days for the data team to write the lift query. Now I ask Folio, get the chart, get the explanation in plain English, and decide before standup ends. Cycle time on experiments dropped 70%.

children: The 'explain this chart' AI is the underrated feature. Execs read the visualization and the one-sentence summary together. Board prep used to take a week of analyst time. Now it's a half-day.

children: Was paying $2.4K/mo for a BI stack that did half of what Folio does on its own. Cancelled everything, switched, and used the savings to hire a part-time analyst who actually spends her time on modeling.
